story: Developers are manufacturing prefabricated apartment buildings
text: Here's a cool video of ToyotaHome (yes, that Toyota) assembling a modular home in Japan: [VIDEO] Their website: [LINK] (JP only, no English)
Toyota manufactures houses in Japan [1]. If they sold them in the US, I'd buy one in a heartbeat. [1] [VIDEO]

It might come down to culture/demand? In Japan where it's preferred to make a new home rather than buy a pre-owned one (outside the big city), pre-fab seems to have taken off rather more (13% of new builds in 2013). For example, a house built in a day (customisable, moderately expensive but very high quality): [VIDEO]
